# data-sources commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `get` | Get details for a specific data source |
| `list` | List registered data sources in the environment |
| `register` | Register a new data source entity in Dataverse |
| `unregister` | Unregister a data source and cascade-delete all child data providers |
| `update` | Update a data source (no mutable attributes; see help) |
